alt_text: Per-session distributions show vertical dynamic RMS, magnitude jerk RMS, shock-spike rate, and cumulative dynamic shock per minute by canonical cohort, with available and missing counts.
interpretation: Mechanical exposure differs across observed mobility and transportation contexts; acceleration, jerk, and shock do not directly measure pain.
limitations: Wearables estimate physiologic, autonomic, MSK, movement, impact, and transport burden. They do not directly measure pain. Results are N-of-1 evidence, not clinical proof, diagnosis, causation, universal proof, or legal proof.
long_description: Mechanical exposure differs across observed mobility and transportation contexts; acceleration, jerk, and shock do not directly measure pain. Each dot is one available canonical episodic session; no missing value is estimated. n and missingness are reported separately for every metric and cohort.
